messages:
maria: Heads up — saw console quick-switch briefly show Project rows from org-B while I was in org-A. Pretty bad repro: click org switch > immediate quickpanel > see stale rows for ~200ms.
aj: ugh. can you paste repro steps + browser + any console logs?
maria: steps: 1) login as org-A, 2) open quick-switch (cmd-k), 3) click org-B in the switcher, 4) before route finishes, hit "Open dashboard" from quick results. Happens on latest Canary Chrome. Console shows: "rendered rows org=B (ctx org=A)".
kevin: any network trace? maybe prefetch/respond ordering?
maria: attaching short trace below (copied headers):

--- network snippet ---
GET /internal/api/console/runlist 200
req headers: { cookie: "session=abcd; workspace=org-b", x-workspace: "org-a" }
resp: 200 payload rows(org-b)
--- end ---

aj: hmm that looks like the route mux updated x-workspace after cookie change race. Our prefetcher is still reading cookie-scoped workspace id to build cache key. If cache key uses cookie but request uses header, mismatch.
samir: we should short-circuit at the internal API too. Defensive check: if x-workspace header and authenticated session workspace disagree, log and reject. Add a metric e.g. "tenant_mismatch.reject_count".
maria: stack trace from client console after repro: "TypeError: hydrating rows for org-b into org-a table" then UI flashes and corrects itself when final route response arrives.
deploy-bot: deploy prod-frontend @ 2023-07-15T11:20Z (sha: f9a1c2)
aj: proposed fix: 1) make prefetcher include explicit workspace header in cache key (no cookie fallthrough), 2) server: prefer x-workspace over cookie for resolution and emit telemetry when they differ, 3) add guard at internal API returning 409 if mismatch for change-of-view routes.
kevin: also consider setting cookie "Workspace" path+scope to /;Secure;SameSite=Strict so it can't be used by prefetchers cross-route. But that might be backwards incompatible for some SSP flows.
elaine: product: we need minimal user-visible rollback risk. Can we canary this to 5% of traffic first? Also add a dashboard tile to watch "tenant_mismatch" spikes.
aj: yep — plan: patch prefetcher (fe) + add server telemetry (be) in one release, but flag rollouts: feature-flag prefetch-key-change. Can deploy server-side immediately but gate client by flag.
samir: I'll add a quick sentinel in internal-api to count mismatches and return 409 for write-like ops (create/run) but 200+warning for read ops while we observe. That reduces blast.
maria: test matrix: a) fast switch+open b) switch via keyboard c) simultaneous multi-tabs.
aj: code snippet for prefetch key change:
```js
// old: key = `prefetch:${cookie('workspace')}:runs:${query}`
// new: key = `prefetch:${header('x-workspace') || cookie('workspace')}:runs:${query}`
```
aj: also add Vary: X-Workspace on responses that are cached to make proxies safer.
kevin: add an enforcement in the internal auth middleware: if user session.workspace != header.x-workspace then log, incr metric, and for now set resp header X-Tenant-Mismatch: true. Avoid 5xx until we've seen the distribution.
samir: created ticket infra-1242 to add the metric and the 409 guard for write endpoints. Assigning to @aj for FE change and @kevin for auth middleware. ETA: hotfix branch today, canary tomorrow.
maria: assigned. I'll own the regression test and add a short QA script.
elaine: product asks: can we update Rollouts UX to show tenant mismatch metric in the rollout panel for quick rollback signal? small ask but helpful.
aj: will add metric hook to rollout dashboard. Also add a short alert: if tenant_mismatch.rate > 0.5% in 5m, page eng-oncall.
maria: thanks — doing verification now. Will post logs and minimal repro gif when I have it. :eyes:
kevin: also note: add changelog entry for cookie scope change in internal notes.
samir: ok cool. I'll flip the sentinel to strict reject for writes after 24h observation if metric stable.
maria: leaving the thread so it's discoverable — ping me if you need steps or help with repro. :thumbsup:
